_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 7% coil base rate and flat momentum leave HOLD as the skilled default until a named breaker (F&G/VIX/funding or ETF-momentum surge) appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No; analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency, narrative silent on forward phase (commodity tape only)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54, 30d momentum near flat, VIX subdued, no funding flip
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <39 with VIX spike and funding flip (down to Anxiety) or ETF flows + momentum push score through 55 (up to Disbelief)
